definitions.explanation: Reading quickly by letting the eyes flow over the text without carefully reading every word, picking up the general meaning or key points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have time, so I skimmed the report.

examples.japanese: {流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見落|みお}とす→見落とす：04578_miotosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: Skimming can cause you to miss important points, so you should read contracts carefully.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to let flow) and ⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ (reading). The image is of letting your eyes "flow" over the text rather than stopping to absorb each word. The verb form is {流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to skim-read
- {流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to get by with just skimming
- ざっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{流|なが}し{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to quickly skim through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: skimming, reading diagonally — similar meaning, another common word for reading quickly
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧: speed reading — implies a trained technique for reading quickly while retaining comprehension
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: close reading — the opposite: reading carefully and thoroughly
